Hi Priya —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and the next steps we agreed on so everything is in one place: 

Call recap (high level):
- Use case: anonymized customer support summarization + routing (short text snippets).
- Traffic: ~5k requests/day initially, burst to 20k/day during peak.
- SLA needs: 99.9% uptime, P95 < 300ms for short prompts.

Data & privacy points you raised:
- Training-on-customer-data: AcmeFin requests that data sent to Redwood NOT be used to improve Redwood models (no model training/weights updates).
- PII: you prefer that Redwood not persist raw PII; you asked about built-in PII redaction and guidance for customer-side redaction before sending.
- Logging & retention: target retention window you mentioned is 90 days for request/response logs; need an option to disable longer-term telemetry.
- Data residency: assets must remain in US regions (us-east-1 preferred) and not be replicated to other regions for processing/storage.

Agreed next steps:
1) I will send a short confirmation email documenting the opt-out for training-on-customer-data and the requested retention/residency controls.
2) I'll attach our DPA redline and the security questionnaire we discussed for your procurement team.
3) We (legal + security) will add a clause to the DPA that sets training_on_customer_data = false for AcmeFin and includes the retention/residency commitments.
4) Procurement (Amit) will review the DPA and route via DocuSign when ready.

Attachments: AcmeFin_DPA_redline_v1.pdf (pdf), AcmeFin_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx)

Let me know if I missed anything. If that all sounds right, reply to confirm and we'll loop in legal to provide final wording.

Thanks,

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming AcmeFin's requirements so there's no ambiguity: 

- Training-on-customer-data: AcmeFin requires that Redwood not use any AcmeFin customer data to train or improve Redwood models. This must be explicitly stated in the contract.
- Retention: Logs (request/response + metadata) retained for a maximum of 90 days; we expect the option to turn off analytics exports and model telemetry for our tenant.
- PII: AcmeFin will still take responsibility for removing direct identifiers where possible; however, we ask Redwood to provide guidance and an optional PII-filtering pipeline.
- Residency: All processing and storage must remain in the US (us-east-1). No automatic cross-region replication to EMEA/APAC.

Procurement (Amit) will review the DPA redline and reach back on the DocuSign route. Please provide an explicit statement of the training opt-out in the DPA and any audit evidence we can reference (SOC 2 + confirmation clause).
